thread:
Rafael: Quick sync  ops want autoswitch fallback live for rollout v2. We need to lock down how overrides and audits appear so SOC/SRE don't get noisy.
Tess: Two priorities: compact reason taxonomy and sampling strategy. If we sample everything we drown.
Uma: Proposal: front-load sampling for the first 20m (20%) then geometric decay to 1% over 12h. captures early faults.
Vik: Sounds good. Also add a "fallback digest" entry in the rollout timeline that aggregates sampled events (counts + top reasons) not full traffic.
Rafael: On reasons: current codes are ambiguous. Suggest enum strings: latency_p95, error_5xx, quota_breach, service_unavailable, model_mismatch.
Tess: Add `degrade_mode` too: hard, soft, trial. UI can show pill: `soft 3%  latency_p95` where 3% is fallback rate.
Uma: Operator controls: Snooze quick actions (5m/30m/2h) without note; Hold override requires a short rationale and produces a full audit row.
Vik: Implement cooldown for hold overrides: sequence 0m -> 10m -> 1h -> 6h. UI should display current cooldown state and history: `holds:2 (last:Tess 11m ago)`.
Rafael: For audit schema, include fields: decision_id, rollout_id, decision_ts, fallback_reason, degrade_mode, override_type, override_actor, override_ttl, policy_revision, prev_route_id, fallback_variant. That way replay will work.
Tess: In console, show a collapsed list under rollout: "Fallback digest (sampled)" -> top reasons + one example trace link + last override entry. Clicking expands full audit list (paginated).
Uma: Metric queries: `from rollouts where id='<id>' and decision='fallback' | summarize count() by fallback_reason, override_type`. Add a saved query in the console.
metrics-bot: Alert: rollout-v2-autoswitch scheduled by @Rafael at 1763332490. Monitoring channels subscribed.
Vik: Action items: Tess will mock digest UI + override flows, Uma will author sampling decay logic and add tests, Rafael will write telemetry schema diff and migration notes, I'll add cooldown enforcement to operator-api.
Rafael: Let's hold flip if mocks not in by EOD. If ready, flip tomorrow. Any objections?
Tess: No objections. Figma mock incoming.
Uma: PR for sampling by 4pm.
Vik: I'll open infra ticket and link.
Rafael: Thanks all :thumbsup:
